briefing: Markets were neutral today (NASDAQ -0.9%, S&P500 -0.4%) with no clear risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($289.29) is below the $500 buy threshold, so no new positions were opened; existing holdings were left untouched to let stop-loss and profit targets work automatically.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" means keeping cash available instead of investing it immediately, so you can act decisively when a strong opportunity appears. On a neutral day like today, with cash below the position-sizing threshold anyway, holding rather than forcing a trade preserves flexibility for a clearer setup.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指保留現金而非立即全數投入，以便在真正出現強烈機會時能果斷行動。像今天這種中性交易日，加上現金本就低於建倉門檻，選擇持有而非勉強交易，能保留應對更明確買入時機的彈性。

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices drifted lower today in a broad, low-conviction pullback rather than a sharp selloff tied to any single catalyst. Without a clear risk-on or risk-off trigger, trading volume and momentum signals across the screened list stayed mixed, which is typical of a consolidation day after recent gains. Days like this often precede either a continuation lower or a bounce, so staying disciplined rather than chasing either direction tends to pay off.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日兩大指數均溫和回落，屬於缺乏單一催化因素的普遍性、低信心度回調，而非急跌。由於沒有明確的風險偏好或避險訊號，篩選名單中的成交量與動能指標普遍呈現參差不齊，這在近期上漲後的整理日相當常見。此類交易日往往預示著後續可能延續跌勢或反彈，因此保持紀律、不輕易追價往往是較穩健的做法。
